evidence.operator_observation: Overlapping header/search elements are visible across multiple Prompt Kit versions.

requirements.expected: Brand/title/version block and search control bounding rectangles do not intersect.
Filter controls and search control bounding rectangles do not intersect.
Interactive header controls remain inside the header layout box.
Document scroll width does not exceed viewport width because of header controls.
When available inline width is insufficient, controls wrap, shrink, or move to a subsequent row before collision.
Responsive reflow does not make search, clear, filter, or title controls unusably small or inaccessible.

proof_ceiling: This harness records the regression and acceptance geometry. Until product code is repaired and browser geometry is executed, implementation remains a known defect.
